nom: L'Oréal Revitalift Vitamin C Vitamin E Salicylic Acid Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum did not add to oiliness and one long-term user says it helps decrease oil production over time.
segments.dry: One reviewer with a dietary reaction and rough skin saw improvement overnight, and another reports the serum makes skin look radiant rather than dull and dry.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination (dry with oily patches) skin reports it did not clog pores in oily areas nor leave the rest of her face rough or patchy.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no burning, itching, or reaction and a clean or minimal scent, though one sensitive-fragrance warning is noted by another reviewer.
segments.mature: A reviewer noted one expression line smoothed and smaller-looking pores after starting use, and another with fine lines and dark spots saw a difference reported as looking younger.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoothed expression lines, smaller-looking pores, and reduced appearance of fine lines and dark spots after use; no dissent noted on this concern specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe skin feeling softer, smoother, and more moisturized, with one saying it left skin 'not dry' and glowing instead of dull.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports the serum's warming sensation was not accompanied by redness, and another reports reduced redness after two days; no reviewer describes new redness from the product itself.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer states other vitamin C and retinol-type products caused irritation and painful peeling in the past, and that this serum did not cause that reaction; another reviewer with sensitive skin had no burning or itching.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report brightened dark spots and more even, radiant-looking skin tone; no dissent reported.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with adult acne reports persistent acne clearing within a month; another reports reduced appearance of blemishes; a third reports one initial breakout attributed to the acid before improvement — most describe no new breakouts but at least one describes an initial purge.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with very oily skin says it did not add to oiliness, and a long-term user reports it decreases oil production; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Leaves skin smooth and silky, not greasy

extraits.titre: If you struggle with adult acne, this is for you.
extraits.texte: This may not be the ~perfect~ product, but it sure as heck does an amazing job. Within a month, I noticed my skin retaining more moisture, my persistent acne clearing, and my face less oily after a long day. The key to not letting it oxidize as quickly is to apply it were needed quickly, and the honestly not dilly-dallying when screwing the cap on. This serum lives on my bathroom sink, and it took about a month to become fully oxidized (and that's because I didn't use it religiously at the end of it's lifecycle - a girl just was letting her whole skincare routine go for a bit 🙃). Even with oxidation, the product still does it's job, you just need to apply more. The pilling is your issue layering products (I said what I said). To avoid the 'oompa loompa' face, you should get a mineral primer. It basically resets your skin/base back to normal color. Now, all of that, I don't think I'd tell cooler undertones to buy this product, because you'll be disappointed. But for all of my warm tone gals, yeah - I totally recommend this just based off effectiveness and price.

I have combination skin. It's mostly dry with a few oily patches, but it makes it so hard to find a good serum for my face. This one did not clog my pores in my oily spots, nor did it give me rough, patchy skin on the rest of my face. Overall very happy with it!

I've tried many of the serums L'Oreal Paris has to offer and this is definitely my favorite. I have very oily skin and this serum did not add to my oiliness. It also smells like citrus so that was a plus.

I requested a sample of this serum to try since I have sensitive skin and worry about using some products and having burning or itching. I was happy surprised how much I liked this. It wasn't sticky and wore well under foundation or powder. I had no reaction or sensitivity to the serum. It had a very minimal, clean scent. I plan to buy this product. #GiftedbyLorealParis

I had bought this before and it was good but decided to try other recommendations, at first it burned a bit after washing my face alone, but now I put toner then this and moisturizer and it been doing well I have tried many brands even le Mer, but all others have made me very irritated and peel painfully I just recovered and decided to go back to this and with the night midnight moisturizer its been great.

It is my first time using vitamin C serum, and I'm pretty happy with this product. One expression line that I had has been smoothed since I started using it, and the pores have become smaller as well.

I bought this because i have textured, acne prone skin. I really liked the serum - it felt nice on my skin and absorbed well (or so i thiught). After about 3 hours, i realized it had oxidized on my face. As a fair skin girl, it was incredibly obvious that there was an orange film on my face and neck.
